title: FA Renewed
description: This resource pack updates a huge number of different textures in the Eras of Arda: Renewed Addon (First and Second Age) mod
body:
## FA Renewed

This resource pack updates and is an addition to _Eras of Arda: Renewed Addon (First and Second Age)_

During its development, many textures of blocks, tools, weapons and models were updated in order to immerse yourself in the world of First Age of Middle-earth.

As the creator of the resource pack, I don't know if I'll be making further updates in the future. I've already done everything I wanted to implement in my project. The only thing I might do is release minor updates in the future.

If you want to contact me, my Discord profile is - [https://discordapp.com/users/725646391547789312](https://discordapp.com/users/725646391547789312)

What you see in the gallery isn't all of the resource pack's content. Much hasn't been shown yet. You can play the game with this resource pack and see all the updated textures.

![hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a7011c3dcefd68a5bff824f5a95608081f32511.png)
